items.difficulty_reason: The counted proposition is the author proposition at source lines 879-882: there is a surjection from the positive integers onto A iff there is a surjection from the natural numbers onto A. The author proof (884-889) must produce the shifted function in both directions, g(n) = f(n+1) and f(n) = g(n-1), and each direction needs a short surjectivity check against the definition of surjectivity, using that the domains differ by the single point 0. Both constructions and both verifications are required, so the unit is a real if small argument about reindexing enumerations.
